name: Bague Lucia
ligne: Solitaire, Lucia tient à peu de chose, des courbes fines, quatre griffes et une pierre.
description: Bague Lucia, or blanc, jaune ou rose 750/1000, ou bicolore, sertie d’un diamant rond de 0,40 carat.

en.ligne: A solitaire, Lucia rests on very little, fine curves, four claws and one stone.
en.description: Lucia ring in 18ct white, yellow or rose gold, or two-tone, set with a 0.40ct round diamond.

it.ligne: Solitario, Lucia vive di poco, linee sottili, quattro griffe e una pietra.
it.description: Anello Lucia in oro bianco, giallo o rosa 18 kt, o bicolore, con un diamante rotondo da 0,40 ct.
